parameters.query: SELECT j.job_id, j.job_type, j.entity_id, j.correlation_id, j.payload, j.attempt, ch.id AS channel_id, ch.name AS channel_name, ch.platforms, ch.clip_min_seconds, ch.clip_max_seconds, ch.rules, ch.timezone, ch.quality_threshold, n.name AS niche_name, n.keywords FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = NULLIF(j.payload->>'channel_id','')::uuid LEFT JOIN niches n ON n.id = ch.niche_id WHERE j.job_id = $1::uuid AND j.status = 'running'

SELECT ac.id AS creator_id, ac.creator, ac.external_channel_id, ac.permission_status FROM authorized_creators ac JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = $1::uuid LEFT JOIN niches n ON n.id = ch.niche_id WHERE ac.status = 'active' AND ac.platform = 'youtube' AND ac.permission_status <> 'rejected' AND (cardinality(ac.niche_slugs) = 0 OR n.slug = ANY(ac.niche_slugs)) AND (ac.expiration_date IS NULL OR ac.expiration_date >= current_date)

parameters.jsonQuery: ={{ JSON.stringify({ part: 'snippet', type: 'video', channelId: $json.external_channel_id, q: $json.q, order: 'relevance', videoDuration: 'long', maxResults: 8 }) }}

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Load Job').first().json.job_id, JSON.stringify({ registered: $('Register Source (dedup + enqueue rights)').all().map(i => i.json.ca_register_source) })] }}
